products.title: Luna Rossa Ocean EDT 50 ml
products.description: Formulated by IFF Master Perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim, Prada Luna Rossa Ocean has a unique neo-fresh olfactory signature that reinvents the emblematic fougère family. Sublimating notes of aromatic freshness mixed with the sophisticated sensuality of bergamot, a contrast is created with the sophisticated essence of vetiver. Everything intertwines in the heart notes with an elegant iris accord.
